content.thinking:
I'm weighing silent data corruption against a bad deployment for the month-total drop. The metrics stayed flat and the reconciliation caught it, so I'm leaning toward silent data corruption, since the bad-deployment label only fits when the request-level series moved. I still need to settle whether the subject is the revision or the file.

I'm settling on the subject now: the revision, since the explanation that blames the change a different way treats it as the same subject.

hypotheses.subject: 26f1d7e2c82ce2abff8f9b6424dc226f4f37fed2
hypotheses.summary: Revision 26f1d7e2c82ce2abff8f9b6424dc226f4f37fed2, deployed at 2026-10-29T00:57:18Z, changed record_purchase in purchase_ledger.py so it no longer maintains the stored month total.
